name: tokensculpt
displayName: TokenSculpt — AI Token & Cost Optimizer (Copilot & Claude)
description: Save 60–90% AI token & LLM costs across GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex. Zero-latency context pruning, AST skeletons, semantic cache, and real-time savings tracking.

commands.title: TokenSculpt: Reset Complete Data (Wipe All History)

tokensculpt.enabled.description: Enable or disable all token optimizations.

tokensculpt.autoApply.description: Automatically apply token optimization directives when opening a workspace.

tokensculpt.targetTools.markdownDescription: Which AI tools to generate instruction files for. Leave empty (default) to auto-detect based on installed IDE extensions. When set explicitly, only the listed tools will receive instruction files.

tokensculpt.autoDetectTools.markdownDescription: Automatically detect which AI tools are present in the current IDE (Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity) and generate only the relevant instruction files. Disable to fall back to `copilot` only or set `#tokensculpt.targetTools#` explicitly.

tokensculpt.profile.description: Active optimization profile. Profiles control which strategies are enabled.
enumDescriptions: All 20 strategies active — maximum enterprise token & cost savings
Disables output compression and diff-only for full log & test diagnostics
Disables verbosity restrictions and guardrails for deep architectural reviews
Preserves full context history and comments for thorough code reviews
Use custom strategy combination from activeStrategies setting

outputCompression.description: RTK terminal and test output compression

sessionManagement.description: Context compaction and multi-turn session pruning

semanticCache.description: Local semantic cache (zero model tokens for repeated questions)

astSkeleton.description: AST type skeleton extraction (~90% smaller file context)

contextExclusion.description: Smart context exclusions (auto-exclude lockfiles, dist/, minified code)

diffOnlyOutput.description: Diff-only output format (~92% output token savings)

agentGuardrails.description: Loop guardrails (prevents expensive runaway retry cycles)

smartModelRouting.description: Smart model routing (suggests lighter models for routine edits)

gitDiffContext.description: Git diff scoping (restricts reviews to git diff + 1-hop callers/callees)

kvCacheAlignment.description: Prompt prefix caching (maintains byte-aligned prefixes for cloud KV caches)

commentStripper.description: License header & comment stripper (removes copyright preambles on ingestion)

testFailureIsolator.description: Test failure isolator (extracts failing assertions and line numbers only)

rangeSlicing.description: Windowed range slicing (restricts file reads to 100-line windows around symbols)

inlineChatScopePinning.description: Inline chat scope lock (constrains inline chat to selected lines + references)

copilotIgnoreGeneration.description: .copilotignore generator (blocks build outputs, lockfiles, and secrets)

copilotEditsAwareness.description: Edit session awareness (avoids re-reading files already in active editor session)

threadResetTrigger.description: Context saturation monitor (suggests fresh thread when conversation exceeds 40 messages)

headroomCompression.description: Headroom reversible context compression & SmartCrusher (CCR with local retrieval)

tokensculpt.activeStrategies.description: Toggle individual optimization features (used when profile is 'custom').

tokensculpt.verbosityLevel.description: Verbosity reduction level: Light (~20%), Full (~35%), Ultra (~50%).

tokensculpt.commentStrippingMode.description: Comment stripping mode: 'headers-only' (safe — strips only license/copyright blocks), 'aggressive' (strips all comments — may reduce LLM accuracy), 'off' (no comment stripping).
enumDescriptions: Strip only license/copyright header blocks (safe, preserves inline comments for LLM comprehension)
Strip all comments including inline and block comments (saves more tokens but research shows up to 3x accuracy degradation)

tokensculpt.preserveExistingInstructions.description: Preserve existing user content in instruction files when updating.

tokensculpt.autoInstallTools.description: Automatically check and install supporting CLI tools.

tokensculpt.configureMcpOnActivation.description: Automatically configure 100% on-device MCP servers (token-cache, headroom, CodeGraph) on activation.

tokensculpt.pricing.description: Model pricing table in USD per 1M tokens (used for savings dashboard calculations).

maxRetries.description: Max retry attempts before pausing for user confirmation

maxFilesPerTask.description: Max files to modify in one task before asking confirmation

maxFileReads.description: Max reads of the same file in a single conversation

tokensculpt.guardrails.description: Agent loop guardrail limits to prevent runaway tool usage.

tokensculpt.useVscodeStorage.description: Store instructions cleanly in .vscode/copilot-instructions.md instead of modifying public git tracking. Use 'Export to Repository' command when team-wide repo commit is desired.

tokensculpt.githubInstructions.description: Write instructions to .github/ (the path VS Code Copilot auto-discovers). Recommended: true. Set false only if you prefer to keep all generated files out of git.

tokensculpt.githubStructureMode.description: How TokenSculpt integrates with .github/: 'auto' detects structured layout (.github/instructions/), 'flat' writes directly to .github/copilot-instructions.md, 'structured' writes to .github/instructions/tokensculpt.instructions.md.

tokensculpt.generateAgentFiles.description: Scaffold TokenSculpt agent (.github/agents/tokensculpt.agent.md) and optimization skill (.github/skills/tokensculpt-optimize/SKILL.md) in structured .github repositories.

tokensculpt.telemetry.enabled.description: Enable 100% on-device token and cost savings tracking.

scripts.version:patch: npm version patch && npm run changelog
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor && npm run changelog
scripts.version:major: npm version major && npm run changelog
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && npm run changelog && npm run package
